_note: Pets (server-owned). Prices, satiety per food, pickup reach and the support buffs are a BALANCE PROPOSAL pending owner approval. A pet never creates Gold: it only collects the owner's own drops (same server drop, paid once). tier normal = sold for Gold, vip = Diamonds (payments are off: Diamonds cannot be bought yet). rarity = common/rare/epic/legendary (display). Support buffs apply only while the pet is out and fed: reachBonus (metres added to the pickup reach) and potionCooldownPct (% shorter auto-potion cooldown). Edit numbers here, never in code.
_autoPotion: Pet auto-potion (PROPOSAL): a fed, summoned pet gives the owner one potion from the bag when HP/MP falls below the player's threshold, on farm maps only, at most once per cooldown per bar.
